summary: The column charges through the Titans the Coordinate has turned. Ymir stays with the warriors so Historia can remain. The escape is not a clean ending.

segments.ja: 座標のあと、巨人の群れは人間ではなく鎧と、指定された一体を向いています。向いた群れの隙間を、調査兵団は突いて通ります。突く動きが、今日の突撃です。突撃は、一対一の勝負ではありません。勝負ではなく、生きたエレンと負傷した団長を壁まで運ぶ直線です。直線の上で、ミカサはエレンの体を支え、アルミンは進路の穴を数えます。数える声が、馬の速度に合わせられます。
segments.en: After the Coordinate, the herd of Titans faces not the humans but the armor and the one body that was indicated. The Survey Corps strikes through the gaps of the herd that has turned. The striking movement is today's charge. The charge is not a one-to-one match. It is not a match. It is a straight line that carries the living Eren and the injured Commander to the wall. On the straight line, Mikasa supports Eren's body, and Armin counts the holes in the path. The voice that counts is matched to the horses' speed.

tokens.note: The power in Eren's scream that can turn other Titans.

segments.titleJa: エルヴィンは下りない
segments.ja: 片腕を失ったエルヴィンは、鞍から下りて治療を待つことを拒みます。拒む理由は、下りた瞬間に直線が曲がるからです。曲がる直線は、日没と巨人の再集結に負けます。負けないために、彼は痛みを速度の一部として扱います。扱う顔を、104期は初めて近くで見ます。見た顔は、残酷であると同時に、自分たちを置いていかない顔です。いかないことが、突撃の指揮です。
segments.en: Erwin, having lost one arm, refuses to get down from the saddle and wait for treatment. The reason he refuses is that the moment he gets down, the straight line bends. A straight line that bends loses to sunset and to the Titans gathering again. In order not to lose, he treats pain as a part of speed. The 104th sees the face that treats it, up close, for the first time. The face they see is cruel and, at the same time, a face that does not leave them behind. Not leaving them is the command of the charge.

segments.ja: ユミルが戦士の馬の側に残る理由は、今日、ヒストリアの側へ言葉で届き始めます。届く理由は、彼女がここにいればヒストリアが報復の名簿から外れる、という計算です。計算は、愛の形としては歪んでいます。歪んでいても、目的は彼女を壁の内で生かすことです。生かすために、ユミルは自分の過去を戦士たちの取引に載せます。載せた過去には、マルセルの負債が含まれます。含まれる負債を、彼女はヒストリアには完全には書きません。
segments.en: The reason Ymir remains on the side of the warriors' horses starts, today, to reach Historia's side in words. The reason that reaches is a calculation: if she is here, Historia comes off the list of retaliation. As a shape of love, the calculation is warped. Even warped, the purpose is to let her live inside the walls. In order to let her live, Ymir puts her own past onto a trade with the warriors. The past she puts on includes the debt of Marcel. She does not write the included debt completely to Historia.

segments.titleJa: ヒストリアは追わない
segments.ja: ヒストリアは、ユミルを取り戻す突撃に自分を加えません。加えないことは、諦めだけではありません。だけではなく、相手の計算を受け取ったうえでの停止です。停止した彼女は、クリスタの役にも戻りません。戻らない名で、彼女は遠ざかる背中を見送ります。見送る目は、子供の季節が終わった目です。終わった目が、なおユミルの生存を願っています。願いは、突撃の直線とは別の方向です。
segments.en: Historia does not add herself to a charge that would take Ymir back. Not adding herself is not only resignation. It is a stop after receiving the other person's calculation. She, who has stopped, also does not return to the role of Christa. In the name that does not return, she watches the back that draws away. The eyes that watch are eyes for which the season of being a child has ended. The ended eyes still wish for Ymir's survival. The wish is a different direction from the straight line of the charge.

segments.ja: ベルトルトは、逃走の中で故郷の方向を手放しません。手放さないことが、彼の戦士としての残りです。残りは、ライナーの確信より細いです。細い残りでも、彼は超大型の力を温存し、壁の内へは戻りません。戻らない選択を、アルミンは森で揺らした言葉の失敗として受け取ります。受け取る失敗は、相手が怪物だったからではありません。人間のまま、別の故郷を選んだからです。選んだ事実が、追撃の終わりを早めます。
segments.en: In the flight, Bertholdt does not let go of the direction of his hometown. Not letting go is what remains of him as a warrior. What remains is thinner than Reiner's certainty. Even with the thin remainder, he conserves the Colossal's power and does not return inside the walls. Armin receives the choice not to return as the failure of the words he shook in the forest. The failure he receives is not because the opponent was a monster. It is because, while still human, he chose another hometown. The fact of the choice hastens the end of the pursuit.

segments.en: Reiner's armor is wounded by the fangs of Titans that turned toward the Coordinate. Even with wounded armor, he does not step down from the role of carrying Ymir and Bertholdt outward. The back that does not step down has the same shape as the back that pushed recruits up at the tower. The same shape is, today, an enemy's flight. Eren knows the shape of the flight from very near. Knowing it does not simplify the hatred. He is stuck, on the charging horse, with hatred that will not become simple. Even stuck, the column does not stop.

segments.ja: コニーは突撃の中で、ラガコの無人をまだ胸に残しています。残した無人と、人が巨人になる仮説が、同じ速度で揺れます。揺れる胸のまま、彼は馬を壁の方向へ走らせます。走らせる隣で、サシャは食料ではなく進路の危険を呼びます。呼ぶ声は、村の娘の声のまま、兵士の情報です。情報を、二人はライナーの背中へは送りません。送らないことが、もう仲間ではないという身体の理解です。
segments.en: In the charge, Connie still keeps Ragako's emptiness in his chest. The emptiness he kept and the hypothesis that people become Titans shake at the same speed. With the shaking chest, he runs the horse toward the wall. Beside the running, Sasha calls out the danger of the path, not food. The voice that calls is still a village daughter's voice, and it is a soldier's information. The two of them do not send the information toward Reiner's back. Not sending it is the body's understanding that he is no longer a comrade.

segments.ja: ジャンは、快適な席を選ばなかった自分を、この直線で試されます。試される内容は、憎しみに速度を奪われないことです。奪われないために、彼はライナーの顔を一度だけ見て、すぐに蹄の前の巨人を見ます。見る順番が、今日の彼の成人です。成人は、マルコに報告できる種類の綺麗さではありません。ありませんが、列を抜けないという事実です。事実を、彼は自分の翼の定義に加えます。
segments.en: On this straight line, Jean is tested as the person who did not choose a comfortable seat. The content of the test is not having his speed taken by hatred. In order not to have it taken, he looks at Reiner's face only once, and immediately looks at the Titan in front of the hooves. The order of looking is his coming of age today. The coming of age is not a cleanliness of the kind he could report to Marco. Even so, it is the fact that he does not drop out of the column. He adds the fact to the definition of his own wings.

segments.ja: ミカサの突撃は、エレンを離さないことです。離さないことが、座標のあとでも変わりません。変わらない腕が、彼の空洞を壁まで運びます。運ぶ途中で、彼女はハンネスの不在を一度だけ背後に感じます。感じた不在は、速度を落としません。落とさないことが、冷たいのではなく、生きている者の義務です。義務の先に、門があります。門は、まだ開いています。
segments.en: Mikasa's charge is not letting go of Eren. Not letting go does not change even after the Coordinate. The arm that does not change carries his hollow as far as the wall. segments.en: In Historia's hands there is not yet a complete letter from Ymir. In place of what is not there, only the gist of the calculation has arrived. segments.en: The inside of the gate after the charge ends is not a place for cheering. In the place that is not, soldiers get off the horses, count wounds, and set down names that did not return. On the way of carrying, she feels Hannes's absence behind her only once. The absence she feels does not lower the speed. Not lowering it is not coldness. It is the duty of the ones who are alive. Ahead of the duty is a gate. The gate is still open.

vocab.exampleJa: 成人は、マルコに報告できる種類の綺麗さではありません。
vocab.exampleEn: On this straight line, Jean is tested as the person who did not choose a comfortable seat. The content of the test is not having his speed taken by hatred. In order not to have it taken, he looks at Reiner's face only once, and immediately looks at the Titan in front of the hooves. The order of looking is his coming of age today. The coming of age is not a cleanliness of the kind he could report to Marco. Even so, it is the fact that he does not drop out of the column. He adds the fact to the definition of his own wings.

vocab.exampleJa: コニーは突撃の中で、ラガコの無人をまだ胸に残しています。
vocab.exampleEn: In the charge, Connie still keeps Ragako's emptiness in his chest. The emptiness he kept and the hypothesis that people become Titans shake at the same speed. With the shaking chest, he runs the horse toward the wall. Beside the running, Sasha calls out the danger of the path, not food. The voice that calls is still a village daughter's voice, and it is a soldier's information. The two of them do not send the information toward Reiner's back. Not sending it is the body's understanding that he is no longer a comrade.

vocab.exampleJa: 無い代わりに、計算の要旨だけが届いています。
vocab.exampleEn: In Historia's hands there is not yet a complete letter from Ymir. In place of what is not there, only the gist of the calculation has arrived. The gist is: I go outside, and you live by your own name. She does not treat the sentence as a soldier's report. She sets the sentence she does not treat inside her chest. The sentence she sets will become fuel for a later season. The fuel does not burn yet today. She carries the sentence that does not burn, without canceling it.

vocab.exampleJa: 持て余しても、列は止まりません。
vocab.exampleEn: Reiner's armor is wounded by the fangs of Titans that turned toward the Coordinate. Even with wounded armor, he does not step down from the role of carrying Ymir and Bertholdt outward. The back that does not step down has the same shape as the back that pushed recruits up at the tower. The same shape is, today, an enemy's flight. Eren knows the shape of the flight from very near. Knowing it does not simplify the hatred. He is stuck, on the charging horse, with hatred that will not become simple. Even stuck, the column does not stop.

vocab.exampleJa: 計算は、愛の形としては歪んでいます。
vocab.exampleEn: The reason Ymir remains on the side of the warriors' horses starts, today, to reach Historia's side in words. The reason that reaches is a calculation: if she is here, Historia comes off the list of retaliation. As a shape of love, the calculation is warped. Even warped, the purpose is to let her live inside the walls. In order to let her live, Ymir puts her own past onto a trade with the warriors. The past she puts on includes the debt of Marcel. She does not write the included debt completely to Historia.
